correctness.rationale: The exact reduction from Ewens cycles to conditional iid paintbox labels is justified by Kingman/Pitman. A dyadic Borel–Cantelli proof gives the random logarithmic almost-sure limit. Marked run-start indicators have explicit mean and a local exclusion dependency graph, leading to a Chen–Stein bound O_p(k/n); the second-largest mass kills competitor runs and Dickman largest-cycle law identifies the uniform-case mixture. Independent finite code verifies the finite equivalence; it does not certify the limit.
